# Set up TRAE CN

[中文手册](../../../docs/zh/actions/setup-trae-cn.md) · [English guide](../../../docs/en/actions/setup-trae-cn.md)

Install the pinned official China enterprise CLI once, then call the existing `trae-cn` Action.
Reused by Issue analysis, Issue fixes, PR review and CI failure diagnosis.
The installer verifies release checksums and does not require a PAT.
